causal_hypothesis: A trend episode defined by a completed H4 EMA-state transition has positive conditional persistence only when the completed H1 EMA state confirms it; the episode ends when either completed H1 or H4 state turns opposite.

cost_contract.net: gross minus one round-trip cost, consistent with RQ-020E

data_contract.2023_membership: floor first_timestamp_mt4_server to the logical 15-minute server bucket
data_contract.2024_membership: historical UTC converted to MT4 server UTC+2 winter / UTC+3 US DST
data_contract.H1: four exact logical M15 slots per server-hour bucket
data_contract.H4: sixteen exact logical M15 slots per four-server-hour bucket
data_contract.M15_execution_row: first logical M15 bucket at or after event information time; preserve accepted first-tick timestamp as execution audit identity
data_contract.completed_information_time: server bucket close converted through historical ServerToUtc
data_contract.partial_buckets: inventory only; do not update EMA or state

entry_lifecycle.confirmation: first H1 state equal to d within the window
entry_lifecycle.confirmation_window: at the H4 information time observe the co-terminal completed H1 state; if not d, observe at most the next four completed exact H1 bars
entry_lifecycle.entry: next accepted logical M15 open after confirmation information time
entry_lifecycle.hard_exclusion: if that entry M15 is in the frozen low-liquidity exclusion, cancel the episode; do not delay
entry_lifecycle.pending_replacement: a new opposite H4 transition cancels the pending episode and starts the new direction
entry_lifecycle.position_limit: one position; fixed 0.01 lot research sizing
entry_lifecycle.primary_event: completed H4 fast/slow state transition direction d

exit_lifecycle.execution: next accepted logical M15 open after exit information time
exit_lifecycle.fold_boundary_accounting: liquidate an open position at the last accepted M15 open strictly before fold end and flag BOUNDARY_LIQUIDATION; reset position and pending state at the next fold start while retaining indicator warm-up history
exit_lifecycle.normal_exit: first completed exact H1 state opposite the position OR completed exact H4 state opposite the position, whichever information time is earlier
exit_lifecycle.opposite_H4_reentry: the opposite H4 transition that closes a position may simultaneously start a pending episode; a new position still requires the frozen H1 confirmation rule

falsification: no connected component of at least two core cells
no full cell in a core component
any selected result depends on boundary liquidation
default-only effect destroyed by severe costs
direction or date concentration gate failure

finite_grid.parameter_rationale: Natural powers-of-two/session-day scales: H4 spans approximate 12h/2d, 1d/4d and 2d/8d; H1 confirmation spans approximate 4h/16h and 8h/32h. They are not selected from outcomes or claimed literature-optimal.

family_region: at least two Manhattan-adjacent grid cells pass every core gate
at least one cell in that connected component passes every full and pooled gate
collapse exact trade-key/outcome equivalence before counting
maximum one representative after the family region passes
full_each_fold: default net excluding best two entry dates > 0
severe net excluding best two entry dates > 0
pooled: long positions >= 20% and short positions >= 20% of pooled positions
boundary-liquidation trades are not required for positive default or severe net

indicator_contract.EMA: pandas ewm span, adjust=false, min_periods=slow span; MQL4 parity must reproduce the same recursive alpha=2/(span+1) initialization before 2025
indicator_contract.state: +1 when fast EMA > slow EMA; -1 when fast EMA < slow EMA; 0 before both initialized or exact equality
indicator_contract.transition: state changes directly from -1 to +1 or +1 to -1 between consecutive available exact bars; a skipped partial bucket does not itself generate a transition

novel_information: Primary entry and termination are both native higher-timeframe events. M15 supplies execution price only.
prohibited: no periods outside the six cells
no H1/H4 threshold, slope or distance filter
no parameter or gate change after outcomes
no MT4 or 2025 until exact finalist freeze and Research-to-MT4 parity
